For sharpness take the convex hull of the origin and a full (d−1)-simplex in the plane with first coordinate one. Its first coordinate has CDF t^d on [0,1] and mean d/(d+1), so the negative coordinate's central upper tail is γ_d. A sufficiently large positive s gives the two shifted tails 0 and 1. In d=1 the interval with a shift past its endpoints realizes equality.

At fixed t, at most V[1−F(t)] of A can lie in the complement of its closed cap. Writing y=a−V+VF(t), max(0,y)−y/2=|y|/2, also checked with 441 exact rational comparisons. In the reverse direction the measurable open lower cap realizes y=0 and its own closed upper cap is empty, including thresholds at or outside the support. This establishes equivalence with s=−t.
